author: jracer15
body:
Hey everyone!  For my next walls map I've decided to go bizarre with this one,  it's basically a land that will dazzle you :D.  It has mooshrooms who want nothing but to be loved, rebellious colored sheep, and climbable clouds!  The map has the cool features to make for some cool gameplay settings.  Speaking of gameplay the map has potions effect all over, the middle which is called the Fortune Tree with diamonds in the leaves also gives you regeneration when you step over there, and the middle quad sections give you jump boost.  And bows have been modified to give off primed tnt effect with the explosion but there is no damage to you or the blocks.  Look at the pics, download and play on the map.  You be singing 'Hooked On A Feeling' once your done...

                                                 I said I'm hooked on a feeling
                                                     And I'm high on believing
                                                    That you're in love with me
                                                      I'm hooked on a feeling
Pictures!
http://imgur.com/a/Y4ynC

Download with YML!
https://www.dropbox.com/sh/jhp3wq3uvz8xoqo/AAAI632W5G-iOrkwWI0hmbJOa

replies.author: KooDaLord
replies.body: -1 extremely blocky and easy to tell world edit, good start though. The clouds are just spheres ._. Try using this brush for clouds: //br sphere 4%web,96%air 4 then //mask air. Then just hit a few times, not just once. For the tree, its not appealing to the eye or realistic at all. I recommend doing trunks of custom trees by hand, no matter the size. For leaves do //br sphere 5%leaves,95%air <size> then //mask air. Otherwise use voxel for terrain, and the buildings are bland.
replies.body_tagged: -1 extremely blocky and easy to tell world edit, good start though. The clouds are just spheres ._. Try using this brush for clouds: //br sphere 4%web,96%air 4 then //mask air. Then just hit a few times, not just once. For the tree, its not appealing to the eye or realistic at all. I recommend doing trunks of custom trees by hand, no matter the size. For leaves do //br sphere 5%leaves,95%air <size> then //mask air. Otherwise use voxel for terrain, and the buildings are bland.
